verdict.rationale: Ironclad ships an e-signature experience, so signer identity verification is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents SMS codes, ID checks, or knowledge-based authentication for signers. Bring Your Own Signature Provider (BYOSP) only routes signing through a customer-built middleware service, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can require stronger signer identity verification (SMS, ID check, knowledge-based) on sensitive documents
